title: Perpetuity
tagline: Perpetual options market that quickly transfers funds from one wallet to another.
description: Perpetual Options market platform. Our options contracts gives the holder the right to purchase or sell an option without a specific amount of the underlying security for a predetermined (strike) price at or before the option's expiration. A perpetual option that grants the same sort of rights without expiration.
how_its_made: We used Superfluids to build our perpetual options contract. The Chainlink oracle was used to bring in price data and the project was deployed on Polygon for lower gas fees. Now that there are lower gas fees, quicker transactions, and updated price data the perpetual options launched.
